events.name: December 2026 Community Day
events.notes: December 12–13, 2:00–5:00 p.m. local time each day. Saturday features Vulpix, Alolan Vulpix, Grookey, Scorbunny, Lechonk, and Tinkatink, with rare Piplup; Sunday features Zorua, Pawniard, Sobble, Nickit, and Frigibax, with rare Gible and Deino. These hours offer original Community Day Shiny rates and a chance of Special Backgrounds. All featured Pokémon may also appear 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. on either day. Featured evolution moves are available December 12 at 9:00 a.m.–December 13 at 9:00 p.m. Most bonuses run 2:00–5:00 p.m. both days; one-hour Lures, up to two Special Trades per day, reduced trade costs, and the temporary Kingambit evolution requirement run across the entire 9:00 a.m. Saturday–9:00 p.m. Sunday window. Event Field Research and Community Ambassador check-in Timed Research may give Special Background Pokémon. Optional US$4.99 Special Research offers Special Background encounters, an Elite Charged TM, Elite Fast TM, Rocket Radar, and more.
